Cruise Pass Support

Cruise Pass

Extend your Cruise Pass.

Renewing adds another 30 days to the pass your family already has. It keeps the same setup card, so there is nothing to set up again — every phone you already set up keeps working, and family at home stays reachable.

We'll email a link to the address that bought the pass. That's how we know the pass is yours: there are no accounts, and nothing else about your family is stored.

Buy a new pass instead

Already have the link? It came in the email telling you the pass was expiring. Extending early costs no days: 30 days are added to your current expiry date, not to today. Nothing renews on its own, so you are never charged automatically.

Renewing vs buying

  • RenewingExtends the pass your family already has. Same setup card, nothing to set up, everyone's phones keep working exactly as they are.
  • Buying a new passStarts a separate pass with its own setup card, which every phone on it has to be set up with. That's what you want for a different family, not for your own.

Lost the email address you bought with? Email support and we'll sort it out.
